name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v538: TV overlap fix + clearance saving fixed + fail-fast timeout. (1) Invisible Cloudflare solver uses CloudStream's proven attach pattern: full-size alpha=0 container at index 0 of window root, touch passthrough, focus blocked - no challenge page overlaps the CineAnime home on TV. (2) isUsableClearance accepts an existing cf_clearance once the page loads past the challenge instead of waiting 120s for a token Cloudflare never reissues - cookies now actually save and Settings shows Saved. (3) Poll timeout cut from 120s to 30s - fail fast instead of spinning for 2 minutes. (4) Clear all cookies deletes Domain=.host jar variants too. (5) init() runs in background, no app-start freeze. (6) Removed dead JS cookie probe, always require cf_clearance, clear in-flight bypass on dismiss.
